title: Untitled Discourses on Intention Regarding Sights, Etc.
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 11 Numbered Discourses 11.310–357
  • Paṭhamapaṇṇāsaka The First Fifty
  • Sāmaññavagga Similarity

~ Untitled Discourses on Intention Regarding Sights, Etc.

… … Rūpasañcetanāya… “… intention regarding sights … saddasañcetanāya… intention regarding sounds … gandhasañcetanāya… intention regarding smells … rasasañcetanāya… intention regarding tastes … phoṭṭhabbasañcetanāya… intention regarding touches … dhammasañcetanāya… intention regarding ideas. …”
